comments.note: [ActivatorUtilitiesConstructor] is correctly placed on the parameterless constructor, not the 2-parameter constructor. The parameterless ctor delegates to the 2-parameter ctor via ':this(...)' — correct chaining. If the 2-parameter ctor had been marked instead, DI would attempt to resolve IArchiveExtractor twice (circular) and fail at runtime.

ZipArchiveExtractor and TarXzArchiveExtractor are instantiated directly inside the parameterless ctor (not injected from DI). This is intentional — both are stateless and have no external dependencies. If either ever acquires dependencies (e.g., ILogger), the parameterless ctor and DI registration will need revisiting. Worth tracking as a maintenance note.
